description: What VOLO covers and what it does not: the full list of covered occupations and degrees (slug and name), which occupations have no evidence yet, and the counts. Call this when someone asks whether their job is covered, and whenever resolve_occupation_or_major returns null — then decide from the list which entry, if any, the person means. The answer is a fact about this site rather than a guess about their job.
name: describe_coverage
